description: This file defines the TreeCompiler class used for compiling JMESPath expressions into PHP code. It includes methods for traversing expression nodes and generating PHP source code for evaluation.

classes.name: TreeCompiler
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling JMESPath expressions into executable PHP code.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Compiles an AST into PHP code by generating a function with the given name.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a node to the appropriate visit method based on its type.

methods.name: makeVar
methods.description: Creates a unique variable name with a given prefix for use in generated code.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends formatted source code lines to the generated code string.

methods.name: outdent
methods.description: Decreases indentation level in generated code.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Increases indentation level for generated code.

methods.name: visit_or
methods.description: Generates code for logical OR operation nodes.

methods.name: visit_and
methods.description: Generates code for logical AND operation nodes.

methods.name: visit_not
methods.description: Generates code for logical NOT operation nodes.

methods.name: visit_subexpression
methods.description: Generates code for subexpression nodes.

methods.name: visit_field
methods.description: Generates code for accessing object or array fields.

methods.name: visit_index
methods.description: Generates code for array index access.

methods.name: visit_literal
methods.description: Generates code for literal value nodes.

methods.name: visit_pipe
methods.description: Generates code for pipe operation nodes.

methods.name: visit_multi_select_list
methods.description: Handles list multi-select nodes.

methods.name: visit_multi_select_hash
methods.description: Handles hash multi-select nodes.

methods.name: visit_function
methods.description: Generates code for function call nodes.

methods.name: visit_slice
methods.description: Generates code for slicing nodes.

methods.name: visit_current
methods.description: Generates code for current node (no operation).

methods.name: visit_expref
methods.description: Generates code for expression reference nodes.

methods.name: visit_flatten
methods.description: Generates code for flattening array structures.

methods.name: visit_projection
methods.description: Generates code for projection nodes over arrays or objects.

methods.name: visit_condition
methods.description: Generates code for condition (if-else) nodes.

methods.name: visit_comparator
methods.description: Generates code for comparison operations.
